title: AI Summary
headline: Like-for-like revenue increased by +3.0M, while quantity fell by -310.7K across CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021.

sections.heading: Overall Performance
points: Across CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, like-for-like revenue increased by +3.0M (2.5%), from 122.8M to 125.8M compared with the same period last year. Quantity decreased by -310.7K, from 18.9M to 18.6M, while transactions increased by +213.3K (2.6%), from 8.1M to 8.3M. Quantity per transaction changed by -0.10, and average revenue per item increased by +0.27 (4.2%), from 6.5 to 6.8. Revenue improved, but the business sold fewer units and each basket held fewer items.

sections.heading: CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES
points: CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES revenue changed by -722.0K (-5.3%). Quantity changed by -225.0K and transactions changed by -20.3K. Most of CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES's revenue change came from units sold (-1.0M). Within CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES, CF-VEGETABLES reduced revenue by -536.3K. CFH014 led CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES across the stores included in the comparison at +146.2K.

sections.heading: FMCG FOOD
points: FMCG FOOD revenue changed by +539.8K (+1.2%). Quantity changed by -404.4K, while transactions changed by +24.9K. Most of FMCG FOOD's revenue change came from average revenue per item (+2.4M). Within FMCG FOOD, CF-GROCERY FOOD added +344.5K, while CF-CONFECTIONERY reduced revenue by -119.6K. CFH021 led FMCG FOOD across the stores included in the comparison at +513.0K.

sections.heading: CF-MEAT
points: CF-MEAT revenue changed by +721.6K (+9.9%). Quantity changed by +158.9K and transactions changed by +68.2K. Most of CF-MEAT's revenue change came from units sold (+1.9M). Within CF-MEAT, CF-FRESH CHICKEN & PARTS added +1.1M, while CF-FRESH MEAT reduced revenue by -377.8K. CFH018 led CF-MEAT across the stores included in the comparison at +297.5K.

sections.heading: Selected areas in brief
points: CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES was down -722.0K, with quantity down -225.0K and transactions down -20.3K.
FMCG FOOD was up +539.8K, but quantity was down -404.4K and most of the increase came from average revenue per item (+2.4M).
CF-MEAT was up +721.6K, with quantity up +158.9K and transactions up +68.2K.
The named contributors were CF-VEGETABLES at -536.3K in CF-FRUIT & VEGETABLES, CF-GROCERY FOOD at +344.5K in FMCG FOOD, and CF-FRESH CHICKEN & PARTS at +1.1M in CF-MEAT.
